name: Incremental Back-Rotation for Voxel Mapping
aliases: Discrete Tool Rotation (Inverse Method with Optimization)
definition: An algorithm to determine the source voxel position for a destination voxel during room rotation, used to eradicate holes produced by forward rotation.
summary: Incremental back-rotation is a voxel mapping algorithm that prevents image holes by mapping destination voxels to source positions using efficient incremental coordinate updates instead of per-voxel matrix multiplication.
